title: Balanced Accuracy: The Right Metric for Evaluating LLM Judges Explained through Youden’s J statistic
reasoning: The paper focuses on the statistical methodology of evaluation metrics (specifically Balanced Accuracy and Youden's J statistic) for classifiers used as judges in LLM evaluation. While it mentions 'safety violations' and 'policy violations' as target behaviors to be judged, the paper does not engage in Evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, or moral/ethical systems themselves.
